reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising plays an important role in our daily lives. However, powerful advertising can have negative effects on individuals. This essay will discuss the main problems caused by advertising and suggest some possible solutions.
On the one hand, advertising can negatively affect people in several ways. Firstly, it encourages people to buy unnecessary products by making them believe that these products can improve their lives. As a result, they may waste money and have financial problems. Secondly, some advertisements provide false or misleading information about products. For example, advertisements for beauty products may promise excellent results that are not always true. This can make consumers disappointed and lose trust in companies.
On the other hand, governments should adopt several measures to reduce these harmful effects. Firstly, they should introduce strict rules to control advertisements and check their content before they are shown to the public. This can help ensure that product information is accurate and honest. Secondly, there should be restrictions on advertising products on different platforms, especially when advertisements may encourage people to make unnecessary purchases. Finally, schools and families should teach people how to think critically about advertisements and make sensible shopping decisions.
In conclusion, advertising can cause financial problems and mislead consumers. However, these negative effects can be reduced through stricter government regulations and better education about advertising.

Tuy nhiên, bài mới có 221 từ, thiếu 29 từ so với yêu cầu; phần giới hạn nền tảng quảng cáo chưa giải thích rõ vì sao giúp giảm mua sắm không cần thiết. Ví dụ về mỹ phẩm cũng dùng cụm từ sai nghĩa và câu nêu phản ứng của người mua chưa tự nhiên. reviews.suggestedRevision:
Nowadays, highly persuasive commercials can influence how people choose products, sometimes to their detriment. This essay will explain how such advertising can encourage unnecessary spending and mislead consumers, before considering measures that could limit these harms.
Advertising can negatively affect individuals in two ways. Firstly, persuasive messages may make a product appear essential to a better life, even when the buyer does not need it. As a result, people may purchase these products impulsively, waste money and face financial difficulties. Secondly, some advertisements present misleading descriptions of products. For example, beauty product advertisements may promise results that the products cannot reliably deliver. These claims may persuade people to buy products they would otherwise question. Consumers who buy them may then be disappointed and lose trust in the companies responsible.
To address these harms, governments should adopt several measures. Firstly, they should require advertisements to be checked before they are shown to the public. Such checks could compare product descriptions with their actual quality, helping to prevent the misleading claims discussed above. Secondly, governments could limit the number of platforms on which a company is allowed to advertise its products. By reducing repeated exposure to persuasive messages, this measure may help consumers resist unnecessary purchases. Schools and families could also teach people to question advertising claims and consider whether they genuinely need a product before buying it.
In conclusion, advertising may lead people to spend money needlessly and mislead them about product quality. Content checks, sensible limits on advertising platforms and education could reduce these effects.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, video games have become increasingly popular among people of different ages. While some people believe that they provide entertainment and educational benefits, others argue that they can have negative effects on players. In my opinion, although video games have some advantages, their drawbacks outweigh their benefits.

On the one hand, video games can be a good source of entertainment and help people develop useful skills. Firstly, they allow players to enter a virtual world and experience exciting activities, such as racing cars or fighting enemies. This can help them relax after a long day of studying or working. Secondly, some games require players to think carefully and find ways to solve problems. As a result, they may improve their decision-making skills and learn how to work in a team. However, these benefits can also be gained through other activities, such as playing team sports or joining debate clubs, which provide both mental and physical benefits.

On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of video games are more serious, mainly because they can be addictive. Many games offer rewards, new levels and higher scores, which encourage players to continue playing for long periods. For example, children may spend several hours trying to complete a game or achieve a higher score than their friends. Consequently, they may not get enough sleep and may spend too much time sitting in front of a screen, which can negatively affect their health. Furthermore, excessive gaming can prevent students from completing their homework and preparing for exams. This may lead to poor academic performance and fewer opportunities in the future.

In conclusion, although video games can provide enjoyment and help players develop certain skills, I believe that their negative effects, particularly addiction, health problems and poor academic performance, are more significant than their benefits.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng câu hỏi, giữ rõ quan điểm hại nhiều hơn lợi và viết đủ số từ. Hai đoạn thân bài có câu chủ đề, ví dụ phù hợp và các tín hiệu chuyển ý rõ. Tuy nhiên, em chưa giải thích hết vì sao thế giới ảo hấp dẫn, vì sao phần thưởng khiến người chơi tiếp tục chơi, và vì sao hoạt động thay thế ít rủi ro hơn. Em bổ sung các bước ấy cùng tác hại đối với thị lực, vận dụng câu bị động ở chỗ phù hợp rồi nộp lại bài.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, travelling to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole, has become possible for both tourists and scientists. Although this development may have some disadvantages, I believe it is mainly positive because it provides tourists with new experiences and helps scientists gain valuable knowledge.

On the one hand, visiting remote areas allows tourists to discover new things and enjoy different experiences. Although there are many famous tourist attractions around the world, some travellers still want to explore places that are less well-known. For example, when visiting a remote island, tourists can try local food, learn about traditional customs and see rare plants and animals. These experiences can help them understand different ways of life. Granted, some people may argue that they can watch travel programmes on television instead. However, seeing these places in person is much more exciting and meaningful than watching them on a screen.

On the other hand, travelling to remote areas also brings important benefits to scientific research. Even though scientists already have a great deal of knowledge, many natural phenomena remain unknown. By visiting places such as the South Pole or deep forests, researchers can collect information about climate change, wildlife and new viruses. For instance, studying animals in remote environments can help scientists understand how global warming affects their habitats. This knowledge may also help them prepare for future disease outbreaks and find ways to protect endangered species. Therefore, scientific research in these areas can benefit both humans and the natural world.

In conclusion, I believe that allowing tourists and scientists to visit remote natural areas is a positive development. It gives travellers valuable experiences and enables scientists to make discoveries that may improve human life and protect the environment.
reviews.overall: Em giữ được lập trường tích cực, chia rõ lợi ích cho khách du lịch và nhà khoa học, đồng thời mượn lời đúng khi phản bác ý xem qua truyền hình. Tuy nhiên, ví dụ về đảo chưa có việc tham gia nghi lễ của người bản địa; đoạn khoa học chưa nối đủ việc nghiên cứu virus và khí hậu với chuẩn bị ứng phó dịch bệnh, phục hồi môi trường sống. Cô yêu cầu em bổ sung những bước đó, diễn đạt lại câu mở bài bằng lời của mình và tập dùng bị động ở chỗ phù hợp.

criteria.action: Viết lại mở bài bằng cấu trúc khác; thử 'many natural phenomena have not yet been fully understood' và giữ các câu chủ động đang diễn đạt tốt.

studentQuotes: I believe it is mainly positive because it provides tourists with new experiences and helps scientists gain valuable knowledge.

outlineCoverage.requiredText: → CÓ LỢI

studentQuotes: On the one hand, visiting remote areas allows tourists to discover new things and enjoy different experiences.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu chủ đề bao quát lợi ích trải nghiệm cho khách du lịch.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 1: [LỢI CHO TOURISTS]

studentQuotes: Although there are many famous tourist attractions around the world, some travellers still want to explore places that are less well-known.
For example, when visiting a remote island, tourists can try local food, learn about traditional customs and see rare plants and animals.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em giữ nhu cầu khám phá nơi ít người biết, thức ăn, cây cối và động vật hiếm, lối sống khác. Em mới viết 'learn about traditional customs', chưa nói cơ hội tham gia nghi lễ của người bản địa như dàn ý giao.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: - no matter how many tourist attractions there are in the world - globetrotters all around the world still crave novelty → [ex] travel to an island that is unknown to the vast majority of people → travelers - have a chance to participate in exotic religious practices of indigenous people + feast their eyes on rarely seen plants and animals + try new food and experience a whole new way of life

studentQuotes: Granted, some people may argue that they can watch travel programmes on television instead. However, seeing these places in person is much more exciting and meaningful than watching them on a screen.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em gán ý xem truyền hình cho người khác rồi phản bác bằng giá trị của trải nghiệm trực tiếp.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [phản biện nhỏ để kéo dài đoạn - tránh bí ý thiếu từ và tạo điểm nhấn tư duy cho bài luận] Granted, one might say that they can see these things on TV channels dedicated to travel. However, the experience is far inferior to experiencing such activities in person.

studentQuotes: On the other hand, travelling to remote areas also brings important benefits to scientific research.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu mở đoạn nêu lợi ích chung cho nghiên cứu khoa học.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 2: [LỢI CHO SCIENTISTS]

studentQuotes: Even though scientists already have a great deal of knowledge, many natural phenomena remain unknown.
By visiting places such as the South Pole or deep forests, researchers can collect information about climate change, wildlife and new viruses.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em nêu khoảng trống hiểu biết và việc tới vùng xa để thu thập thông tin về các hiện tượng.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → regardless of how much we already know about the world - there is still much that is unknown in the field of science → visit such places - give scientists answers to many existing and future problems

studentQuotes: For instance, studying animals in remote environments can help scientists understand how global warming affects their habitats.
This knowledge may also help them prepare for future disease outbreaks and find ways to protect endangered species.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em có tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu tới nơi sống của động vật và lợi ích chuẩn bị cho dịch. Còn thiếu ví dụ virus mới xuất hiện theo đợt, bối cảnh sinh vật ở biển sâu, nguy cơ dịch bệnh có thể gây tử vong lớn và kết quả phục hồi môi trường sống bị hư hại; 'protect endangered species' không thay đủ ý cuối.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [ex] see this in the way novel viruses break out every once in a while, and how global warming is affecting lives and habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea → understand more about such phenomena - far more prepared for potential outbreaks - kill millions in the future + help restore damaged habitats
